title: El Niño Snowfall
description: A GeoZarr recreation of a NOAA Climate.gov ENSO Blog data product showing ERA5-derived snowfall anomalies over North America during moderate-to-strong El Niño winters (January-March), compared against the 1991-2020 average with the long-term trend removed.

## README.md
# El Niño Snowfall

A GeoZarr recreation of the data product used in the ENSO Blog post [S(no)w pain, S(no)w gain](https://www.climate.gov/news-features/blogs/snow-pain-snow-gain-how-does-el-nino-affect-snowfall-over-north-america) by Michelle L'Heureux and Brian Brettschneider (Oct 2023), as seen on the NOAA Climate.gov's [Snowfall during moderate-to-strong El Niño winters](https://www.usgs.gov/media/images/snowfall-during-moderate-strong-el-nino-winters) map.
